items.q: It was either Ella Fitzgerald -- I'm sure it was Ella Fitzgerald or,

ctx.x: And the only thing Duke and I regretted, Duke and the boys regretted rather, nobody put it on tape or record. That was the greatest thing we ever played. The greatest. That was the greatest concert or the greatest thing we ever done. Everyone said it. And we had guys, because we recorded all the time. How they missed that, I'll never know. How they ever missed that I will never, never know.
